Specialization.Name: Propagandist (reSpecialized) 1.01
Specialization.Description: [H4]Propagandist (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]PROPAGANDIST—PITHY DESCRIPTION[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The propagandist is the covert mass communication specialist. They are the master of disseminating information and putting truths and lies to their best respective truths. They function as a storyteller in a galaxy full of War Stories.[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] ⅓ Group-based Deception ⅓ Group Based Charm ⅓ Knowledge & Perception Utility [BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Twisting broad narratives to influence populations and groups.[BR] Playing up the benefits of the Rebellion for people.[BR] Appearing impartial as an agent of a military unit.[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Being charming[BR] Being Deceptive[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Agitator[i](Have a similar vibe of being something of an agitator in the Imperial sense, but more focused on spreading a message than specifically working and enervating a Rebel cell)[BR] [I]Politico[i](The major overlap is their shared interest in controlling narratives and pulling strings, but the Politico does so for personal gain and on a much smaller scale, whereas the Propagandist tries to sway entire groups of people).
